It evaluates device configuration files against an extensive rule library spanning administrative security, routing protocols, Layer-2 switching, VPN and cryptographic hygiene, management planes, wireless, and vendor-specific hardening requirements.

startups.name: pytllm
startups.description: Run 70B LLMs on a single 4GB GPU without quantization. 405B Llama 3.1 on 8GB, DeepSeek-V3 671B on ~12GB, Kimi K3 2.8T on under 4GB. Layered weight cache breaks the per-token disk re-read.
